_comment: Copy for /request-a-quote — the only page that generates revenue. This is not a contact form: it promises an engineering assessment of a drawing. Every element exists to reduce the hesitation of revealing an unlaunched product to an unknown supplier. Never 'fill in the form below', never 'we will be in touch shortly'. British English.

meta.title: Request a quote — send a drawing, get an assessment | GS Trubna Mebel
meta.description: Send a drawing, a 3D file or a photo of a sample. You get back a manufacturability assessment — where the design drives cost, what it means for tooling — and an indicative price.
